name: researcher
description: One research agent that does its own analysis and keeps a memory you read in the Reader tab: what it is doing, the findings you accepted, what it tried.
greeting:
Researcher: one research agent with a memory.

Run `claude` or `pi` here, whichever this project carries. The agent does its
own analysis in this container, on the data folders you gave the project, and
keeps a memory between sessions under /workspace/memory/. Read it in the
Reader tab: the front page (what it is doing and why), the findings you
accepted, the journal of what it tried, the skills it earned.

A finding enters the record only when you accept it: say "accept F-3".
